description.value:
Usage drawn on a creature

This rune of looping swirls is difficult to look straight at and stirs up a psychic cacophony in a foe's mind. The first time each round the rune-bearer takes an action with the concentrate trait, the turmoil increases, dealing it @Damage[(1 + ceil(@actor.level / 2))[mental]] damage.

Invocation The cacophony fragments and expands rapidly in a mental explosion, dealing @Damage[ceil(@actor.level / 2)d4[mental]] damage to the rune- bearer with a @Check[will|basic|against:runesmith] save. On a failure, the rune-bearer is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure).

Level (+2) The damage from the mental turmoil increases by 1 and the damage of the invocation increases by [[/r 1d4]].
